title: SWOT: inside the firm and outside it
caption: Strengths and weaknesses come from inside the firm; opportunities and threats come from outside it. The regional bus company's four factors show which quadrant each belongs in.
alt: A two by two grid. Internal helpful: strengths. Internal harmful: weaknesses. External helpful: opportunities. External harmful: threats. Each holds the bus company's example.
description: Strengths (internal, helpful): a reliable network and loyal local customers.
Weaknesses (internal, harmful): an ageing diesel fleet.
Opportunities (external, helpful): government funding for zero-emission buses.
Threats (external, harmful): rising fuel costs and car use.
